title: Visit, we beseech Thee, O Lord, this habitation and drive away from it all the snares of the enemy. May Thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace and may Thy blessing be always upon us through Christ, Our Lord. Amen.
html_source:
Short family prayer for the protection of the home.
Printed in capital letters it may indicate a strong participation by the crowd (including Stephen) especially as it is a well known family prayer but probably also the final one

Visit, we beseech Thee, O Lord, this habitation and
drive away from it all the snares of the enemy. May
